people.name: Gibeah
people.line: A city of Benjamin, associated with Saul and atrocities.

translations.web: The ambushers hurried, and rushed on Gibeah; then the ambushers spread out, and struck all the city with the edge of the sword.
translations.bsb: The men in ambush rushed suddenly against Gibeah; they advanced and put the whole city to the sword.
translations.kjv: And the liers in wait hasted, and rushed upon Gibeah; and the liers in wait drew themselves along, and smote all the city with the edge of the sword.
translations.asv: And the liers-in-wait hasted, and rushed upon Gibeah; and the liers-in-wait drew themselves along, and smote all the city with the edge of the sword.
